extracted.name: Lemon Butter Sauce
extracted.description: This lemon garlic butter sauce is rich, flavorful, and SO easy to make! Serve it on pasta, couscous, roasted veggies, and more.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup unsalted butter (cut into pieces)
instruction_lines: Melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat. Add the garlic and salt and cook for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and add the lemon juice. Season with freshly ground pepper and sprinkle with parsley and red pepper flakes, if using.
Serve with steamed artichokes for dipping or toss with pasta. See the blog post above for additional serving suggestions.
